# CEO Executive Brief

## Opportunity Or Problem

What have you observed, and for whom?

## Desired Outcome

What should be meaningfully better when this is delivered?

## Why Now

Why is this the next priority?

## Success Signal

What would you observe from a reader, tester, or the product that would make this worthwhile?

## Constraints And Preferences

Include timing, scope, experience, source, privacy, cost, or technical boundaries you already know.

## Non-Goals

What should this work deliberately leave alone?

## Decisions Already Made

List firm decisions. Leave uncertain implementation details for the delivery lead.
